title.full: What to do about ICA scam calls

summary.text: Ignore the call, share no personal or banking details, report suspected wrongdoing, or call the anti-scam centre.

steps.name: Ignore the call
steps.text: Ignore the call and anything the caller tells you to do.

steps.name: Share no details
steps.text: Do not provide your name, identification number, passport details, contact details, or banking and credit card details.

steps.name: Report wrongdoing
steps.text: Report it to the Police if you suspect any fraudulent act or wrongdoing.

steps.name: Seek scam advice
steps.text: Call the anti-scam centre for scam-related advice at 1800-722-6688.

quotes.text: Ignore such calls and the caller’s instructions
Do not provide personal information such as your name, identification number, passport details, contact details, or banking and credit card details
Report to Police if you suspect any fraudulent act or wrongdoing.
Members of the public can seek scam-related advice by calling the anti-scam centre at 1800-722-6688
